panel_joints.decision: Artem 2026-10-22: joint count and step come from the building's own facade «Цветовое решение» sheet, per facade. AC08 facade 1-2 has 30 vertical ribs and facades A-B and B-A have 12, step 0.20 m (200 px at 1000 px/m), evenly spaced, phase symmetric in the panel field, no horizontal joints. Facade 2-1 is on the sheet and is unmarked (?). The texture supplies colour, noise and the look of one joint only and is not a tiling source. A darker frame band outlines each panel field (top, bottom, corners). The plinth strip is grey RAL 7004 per-sheet. The door is RAL 7004 as on the sheet. Below ±0.000 stays plain colour with no joints. The 0.60 m step and the joint-position cut policy are history. A 0.20 m step needs no new cuts when UV per face lies within one 4K tile; keep an edge loop or ring only where a face still does not fit. VPM diffuse and normal, NPM joints >= 1.5 px. Silhouette, normals, UCX and IDs stay unchanged.
